data.title: 克莱尔 · 晨曦剑术训练场的微汗喘息
data.description: 清晨的学院演武场草坪上，克莱尔将重剑插入地面，一手擦拭着颈间细汗。晨光勾勒出高马尾与挺拔脊背的优美弧线，转头望向来人时神采奕奕。
data.location: dewy morning grassy training field flanked by medieval stone arches
data.action: leaning lightly on sword hilt stuck in grass, dabbing neck sweat with white towel, looking over shoulder with proud confident smirk
data.lighting: crisp golden morning sunlight illuminating athletic ponytail and dewy grass
data.mood: athletic vigor, proud older sister charisma, fresh morning vitality
data.promptProse: On a grassy training field at dawn, black-haired ponytail Claire leans on her sword hilt and wipes sweat with a confident smile.
data.animaCaption: Claire taking a refreshing breath after morning sword training.
